title: ChildAI-Gov: An Evidence-Linked AI System for Assessing EdTech Policies Against Children's Digital Rights
abstract: arXiv:2611.27799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present ChildAI-Gov, an explainable AI system for assessing whether education-technology (EdTech) policies respect children's digital rights. Generative AI is reaching children's education faster than its governance can keep pace, yet checking a tool against children's rights remains manual, expert-dependent, and slow. We propose the Child Rights Impact Score (CRIS), an evidence-linked measure across five dimensions: safety, privacy, transparency, autonomy, and non-discrimination. ChildAI-Gov reads an EdTech tool's privacy or AI policy and scores each dimension by combining a large-language-model judgement (gpt-4o-mini) with a deterministic rule check. translated_title: ChildAI-Gov：一个证据关联的AI系统，用于依据儿童数字权利评估教育科技政策
translated_abstract: 我们提出了ChildAI-Gov，这是一个可解释的AI系统，用于评估教育科技政策是否尊重儿童的数字权利。生成式AI进入儿童教育领域的速度已超过其治理体系所能跟上的速度，然而对照儿童权利来审查一款工具目前仍依赖人工、依赖专家且进展缓慢。我们提出了儿童权利影响评分（CRIS），这是一项与证据关联的衡量指标，涵盖五个维度：安全性、隐私、透明度、自主性和非歧视。ChildAI-Gov读取一款教育科技工具的隐私或AI政策，通过将大语言模型（gpt-4o-mini）的判断与确定性规则检查相结合，对每个维度进行评分。检索增强生成（RAG）组件将每个评分锚定于治理条款，这些条款从精心整理的儿童权利框架知识库（如欧盟AI法案、联合国儿童基金会指南等）中检索获得，因此每个评分都与背后的证据相关联，审计人员可以追溯……
tldr: 该论文提出ChildAI-Gov系统，通过儿童权利影响评分（CRIS）结合大语言模型判断、规则检查与检索增强生成技术，将教育科技政策的合规评估结果与儿童权利框架的证据条款关联起来，实现可追溯、自动化的儿童数字权利评估。
en_tdlr: ChildAI-Gov introduces the evidence-linked Child Rights Impact Score (CRIS), which combines LLM judgment, deterministic rule checks, and retrieval-augmented generation to automatically and traceably assess EdTech policies against children's digital rights across five dimensions.
